name: alert-dialog

frames.best_why: Full dialog in view with title, warning paragraph and both buttons, the clearest read of the whole component.

tagline: Red delete button opens a centred confirm panel with two choices.
summary: A confirmation dialog for destructive actions. A trigger button opens a dark rounded panel on a dimmed page, showing a bold question, a warning paragraph, and Cancel next to a red confirm button.
appearance: A soft red rounded button on a near-black page. Opening it shows a dark rounded panel with a thin border, holding a bold title, a short grey paragraph, and a right-aligned row of two buttons: an outlined Cancel and a pale red confirm.
behaviour: Clicking the trigger fades a black overlay over the page and zooms the panel in slightly. Escape or Cancel dismisses it without acting; the red button confirms, closes and fires the action. Focus stays inside the panel while it is open.
demo_content: Asks 'Are you absolutely sure?' about deleting an account and warns the data cannot be recovered.
search_phrases: are you sure dialog with cancel
popup asking to confirm before deleting
dialog that dims the page behind
use_when: An irreversible action needs an explicit yes, with the consequence spelled out first.
avoid_when: It depends on Radix and a separate button component, and its dark panel assumes a dark theme.
customise: Each part is a separate composable piece, so you supply your own title, description and footer buttons and can override classes on the panel, overlay and header.
weight_why: A small portal panel with fade and zoom classes; nothing runs while it is idle.

a11y.note: Focus trapping, Escape and labelled title and description come from the dialog primitive, but the zoom and fade ignore reduced-motion settings.

issues: The page is already near-black, so the dimming overlay is barely visible when the dialog opens
polish_why: Standard, tidy dialog; the overlay effect is almost invisible on the dark demo stage.
title: Alert Dialog
